cost.method: Independent raw token_count last_token_usage summed once per distinct total_token_usage record in exact stage windows; product rows additionally summed across every recorded Run; no exclusions for failed calls, help, repair or retries. Rate-limit/account fields not collected.
limits: Completed usage generations are not independent HTTP request counts.
Tokens and ratios are not provider bills.
Cache differences are observational, not architectural causality.
P113 is not a denominator; no cross-batch substitution.
Quality and tool-path interpretation belong to separate audits.

notes: Uses existing budget owner unchanged; no new thresholds.
Cumulative raw costs and semantic/instruction/transport acceptance are separate.
No historical native denominator or excluded retry costs.
